answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake that decays with abuse and only returns after a probationary period. A new agent starts as a pearl on a trellis of trust: peers attest to its work, and each successful verifiable transaction adds a link to its reputation lattice. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes faces a steep delta in cost, since every fake must fund its own stake, wait out probation, and earn attestations independently — multiplying cost faster than identity count.
